description: Save a lasting rule from the Developer about how you should work in this project, such as 'ask me before changing the plan'. get_status lists it from then on. Use it only for rules meant to last; a one-off request is just done. A rule the Developer says holds in every project ('in all my projects...', 'always, everywhere...') goes in with global: true: it is saved once for this computer and every project's get_status shows it. With id (s1, s2... in get_status; g1, g2... for a rule for everything): reword it when the Developer changes it, make it hard (hard: true) or ordinary again (false), set the helper limit it holds, or remove it with an empty text. What you leave out stays.

global.description: true for a rule for everything: the Developer says it holds in all their projects ('in all my projects...'). Saved once for this computer; shown wherever Progressor runs.

hard.description: true for a rule that must never be broken (not just a preference); get_status and the session start list those first as HARD RULE.

helpers_at_once.description: Makes this rule the helper limit (in every project, with global): the most helper chats at work at once, such as 1 when the Developer says 'one helper at a time'. Progressor counts the chats running in the project. 0 removes it.

id.description: A rule's ID, such as 's2', or 'g1' for a rule for everything, to change it; leave out to add one.

text.description: The rule, in the Developer's words where possible; with id, empty removes it and left out keeps the wording.

name: save_standing_instruction
title: Save Standing Instruction
